text:
marta: Heads-up — started BMC firmware rollout v2.3.1 to eu-west GPU racks. Canary on rack-3. Seeing 2 nodes unexpectedly flip secure-boot to ENABLED and drop OOB sessions :warning:
jun: Which hostnames? can you paste the BMC IDs?
marta: Sure — `bmc-eu-rack3-07`, `bmc-eu-rack3-11`
marta: Logs from bmc-eu-rack3-07:
```
Apr 22 03:14:02 BMC: fw v2.3.1 apply
Apr 22 03:14:05 BMC: POST complete
Apr 22 03:14:06 UEFI: secure_boot: false -> true (source: firmware)
Apr 22 03:14:07 IPMI: session closed by peer
```
ops-bot: deploy-bot: rollout 1955550000 started by marta (canary: rack-3)
kai: Observed provisioning loop on those two hosts — they PXE, fail UEFI validation, then get removed. Scheduler shows -3 GPUs from eu-west pool (2 failed nodes + 1 evicted).
nirav: If capacity drops further we’ll spill to on-demand in us-west and cost will spike. Can we pause?
marta: Pausing rollout now. Marking canary as FAILED. Will attempt manual rollback per runbook.
marta: Runbook step: `oob rollback-bmc --hosts bmc-eu-rack3-07,bmc-eu-rack3-11 --force`
sre-oncall: Trying serial-over-LAN to bmc-eu-rack3-11 — getting `Session timed out` and repeated `IPMI: network-flap` in BMC logs.
jun: This looks like the update changed how UEFI variables are persisted; firmware notes claimed "preserve secure boot state" but seems buggy when TPM/UEFI NV vars are corrupted.
kai: Vendor/model? are these Supermicro X12 machines? need to check delta between v2.2.9 -> v2.3.1
ops-bot: grid-scheduler: reclaimed 1 job from eu-west and queued 2; backfill pending.
marta: Manual clear worked for bmc-eu-rack3-07 (recovered node), bmc-eu-rack3-11 needed reflashing via USB — currently offline, ETA ~40m. Escalating to hw vendor. :phone:
nirav: Note for finance — if we reprovision 10 more nodes or run more on-demand, we may blow monthly reserved capacity. I'll flag potential overage.
jun: Workaround: disable auto-secureboot toggle in BMC settings across fleet until vendor patch. We can push a config change at rack-level via IPMI.
marta: IPMI command we used:
```
ipmitool -I lanplus -H $BMC -U admin -P $PASS raw 0x2e 0x90 0x01 0x00
# toggles SecureBootAutoCfg = disabled
```
kai: Applied the config change to the canary rack. bmc-eu-rack3-07 came back clean, GPUs reattached. Capacity back to 98%.
sre-oncall: Confirmed scheduler removed grace and jobs rescheduled. No further evictions.
nirav: Please capture the cost impact delta in the incident ticket — we need that for quarterly forecasting.
marta: Creating incident ticket INC-2379 and opening vendor case VC-894. Will schedule a controlled rollout after vendor patch + extra validation (UEFI var snapshot + prefix cache warmup).
jun: Action items: 1) vendor patch PR 2) fleet config toggle until patch 3) add preflight that checks UEFI var checksum 4) run small canary for 24h
marta: Thanks all. tagging infra oncall and vendor. @nirav :thumbsup:
